beats.speech: Stop saying very worried. Here are three better words.
Anxious: My exam is tomorrow. I feel anxious.
On edge: I can't sit still. I'm on edge.
Worried sick: I can't sleep. I'm worried sick.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!
